title: Senior Data Analyst
description_html: Faisal Movers seeks a detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst with at least two years of experience to join their team. This role focuses on maintaining and analyzing comprehensive fleet and vehicle-related data to support operational efficiency and strategic decision-making. The analyst utilizes advanced data visualization tools and reporting techniques, primarily Microsoft Excel and Power BI, to transform complex data sets into actionable business insights. This position suits a candidate skilled in data modeling, statistical analysis, and business intelligence, with a keen interest in transportation or fleet management environments. The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for monitoring fleet performance through meticulous data consolidation and dashboard development. The role requires preparing regular analytical reports that inform management about operational trends and suggest improvements to enhance resource utilization. Although this position does not involve managing a team, the candidate works cross-functionally to support organizational goals through data-driven recommendations and process automation. title: MS Excel Data Analyst
description_html: We are looking for a detail-oriented MS Excel Data Analyst to join our team in Karachi. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and the capacity to work both independently and collaboratively. description_html: Wipro Limited is a global leader in technology services and consulting, dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that address complex digital transformation challenges. With a comprehensive portfolio spanning consulting, design, engineering, and operations, Wipro supports clients in achieving their most ambitious goals and building sustainable, future-ready businesses. Operating across 65 countries with over 230,000 employees and partners, Wipro is committed to helping customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in a rapidly evolving world. title: Lab Analyst
description_html: In this role, you will perform essential laboratory testing to ensure the quality and safety of products. Collaborating closely with teams from laboratory, production, and quality departments, you will contribute to maintaining high standards through accuracy, clear communication, and a positive approach to learning and teamwork. This position provides an excellent opportunity to develop your skills, make meaningful contributions, and advance your career while supporting GSK’s mission to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. Key Responsibilities - Perform routine and non-routine testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using approved methods and laboratory instruments. - Accurately record, review, and report test data using laboratory records and information systems. - Assist in investigations related to unexpected or out-of-specification results and support the implementation of corrective actions. - Maintain inventory of reagents, reference standards, and laboratory supplies; conduct routine equipment checks and basic calibrations. - Participate in method transfer and validation activities, and provide training to laboratory colleagues when required. - Adhere to good manufacturing and laboratory practices, health and safety guidelines, and actively contribute to workplace inclusion and environmental health and safety initiatives. Required Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Pharmacy, or a related science discipline. - Minimum of 1 to 1.5 years of laboratory experience in quality control, analytical testing, or a similar regulated environment. - Practical hands-on experience with laboratory techniques and instruments such as HPLC, GC, UV-visible spectrophotometry, or equivalent. - Basic computer skills including proficiency in MS Office and a willingness to learn laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and SAP. - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively within diverse teams. - Understanding of good laboratory practices (GLP) and good manufacturing practices (GMP), with a commitment to following established procedures. Preferred Skills and Attributes - Attention to detail and a strong focus on data integrity. - Digital fluency and familiarity with GxP regulations. - Experience or knowledge of lean management principles. - Problem-solving skills and risk awareness in quality assurance (QA) and quality control (QC) environments. - Ability to manage testing operations effectively while maintaining compliance with regulatory standards. GSK is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. Our purpose is to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade through innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four key therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases, aiming to improve health outcomes on a large scale. At GSK, people and patients worldwide rely on the medicines and vaccines we develop. We are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and focus on what truly matters. Our culture emphasizes ambition for patients, accountability for impact, and integrity, forming the foundation of how we deliver value to patients, shareholders, and our workforce. Please note, GSK does not accept unsolicited referrals from employment agencies or businesses without prior written authorization. Agencies must contact GSK’s procurement or human resources departments before submitting candidates. Any referrals made without such authorization will be considered unauthorized, and GSK will not be liable for associated fees. Applications for this position can be submitted online through the designated application portal.

description_html: Huzzle connects exceptional talent with leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia, specializing in sectors like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and AI. This role involves owning the full reporting lifecycle and working extensively with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, CRM analytics, and SQL. The successful candidate will not only build dashboards and reports but also proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities, becoming a trusted advisor to leadership. This position requires experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting automation, and strong stakeholder engagement skills. Manage the entire reporting lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment and ongoing optimization. Ensure report accuracy, performance, data refreshes, and KPI consistency. Continuously improve reporting assets as business needs evolve. - Microsoft Fabric & Data Engineering: Develop and manage scalable data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric technologies, including Lakehouses, Warehouses, and Data Pipelines. Create semantic models and support self-service analytics initiatives. Maintain data governance, quality, and consistency, collaborating with technical teams to enhance data architecture and integrations. - CRM & ERP Analytics: Integrate and analyze data from Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and ERP platforms. Develop dashboards covering sales pipeline performance, customer activity, account performance, inventory, and operational metrics. Maintain data integrity across systems to provide a unified business view. - Business Insights & Strategic Analysis: Analyze business trends, anomalies, and opportunities. Deliver regular insight reports and executive presentations. Identify risks and opportunities early to mitigate impact. title: Database Administrator & Data Analyst
description_html: We are seeking a detail-oriented and skilled Database Administrator & Data Analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in managing and analyzing data across multiple systems to support business operations. Responsibilities include data retrieval, database management, campaign data preparation, reporting, and analytics, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and usability of data. This role requires a strong technical background combined with analytical skills to provide actionable insights and improve data-driven decision-making. Key Responsibilities: - Write SQL queries to extract, validate, and reconcile customer, lead, sales, commission, and call-history data from various databases, including Workforce, Atlas, and dialer systems. - Prepare and optimize campaign upload files by applying eligibility criteria, exclusions, deduplication, phone-number normalization, and accurate field mapping. - Evaluate datasets by reviewing past usage and performance to recommend lead pools for campaigns, including refreshing, recycling, or holding data. - Maintain data integrity by investigating missing or conflicting records, optimizing queries, and coordinating database corrections, access controls, backups, and recovery efforts with the technical team. - Analyze contact rates, conversion rates, lead utilization, and campaign/team performance to deliver actionable, data-driven recommendations. - Develop reusable Python scripts and automated workflows for recurring data extraction, cleaning, reconciliation, and reporting, ensuring all processes include documented validation checks. Required Qualifications: - Strong proficiency in SQL and PostgreSQL; experience with MySQL, MariaDB, or Oracle is advantageous. - Skilled in Python, especially using pandas for data manipulation, reconciliation, and automation tasks. - Advanced knowledge of Excel and Power Query; experience with Power BI is preferred. - Experience working with large datasets, handling inconsistent source files, duplicate records, and cross-system data matching. - Ideally, 1 to 2 years of relevant experience. - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to work independently. - Commitment to maintaining confidentiality of customer data. Preferred Qualifications and Benefits: - Experience in call center, BPO, dialer, CRM, or lead-management environments is highly preferred. This role offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where data accuracy and insightful analysis directly impact campaign success and operational efficiency. Candidates interested in contributing their expertise to a collaborative team are encouraged to apply through professional networking platforms.

title: X-ray Image Analyst
company: United Human Resource Services Pvt. Ltd
description_html:
United Human Resource Services Pvt. Ltd is seeking a diligent X-ray Image Analyst with expertise in analyzing container and cargo scanner images to detect anomalies, concealments, and inconsistencies. The ideal candidate holds a bachelor's degree in Physics, Radiology, Imaging Technology, or Computer Science, or equivalent certification with relevant experience, and possesses at least two years of hands-on experience in X-ray image analysis within customs, aviation security, or logistics sectors. This role requires proficiency in using advanced image processing and AI-assisted tools to accurately interpret digital images and prepare detailed findings reports. The X-ray Image Analyst ensures compliance with prescribed standards, maintains case records, and collaborates with customs officers to support inspection and security operations effectively. This position demands high visual acuity, color vision, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to maintain focus during prolonged screen-based work. The X-ray Image Analyst independently examines scanned images, validates findings with AI outputs and cargo documentation, and escalates complex cases as necessary. Responsibilities include maintaining updated case libraries, analyzing patterns for continuous improvement, and adhering strictly to confidentiality and information-security protocols. The analyst also participates in ongoing training, proficiency testing, and quality assurance exercises to uphold accuracy and consistency. This role requires flexibility to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends. Candidates must demonstrate sound decision-making, reliability, and the ability to work effectively under pressure, ensuring compliance with the organization's conduct and performance standards.
Responsibilities
  • Examine container and cargo scanner images to identify anomalies, concealments, density/material inconsistencies, undeclared or suspicious goods, and indicators requiring further action.
  • Compare scanned images with AI analysis results, cargo manifests, and declarations to verify consistency between declared goods and scanned contents.
  • Utilize image processing and AI-assisted tools such as zoom, contrast enhancement, material discrimination, measurement, annotation, and automated alerts to validate images before finalizing findings.
  • Record clear, standardized image analysis results for each scan, distinguishing cases needing further review from those with no significant anomalies.
  • Escalate complex or uncertain images to designated supervisors or relevant review authorities for additional assessment.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of image analysis results, case references, decisions, and subsequent examination or seizure outcomes for audits and quality reviews.
  • Prepare and transmit concise official reports, discrepancy notices, referrals, alerts, and other communications to relevant customs formations according to procedures and deadlines.
  • Update and maintain a reference image and case library by adding validated cases, concealment examples, anomalies, and confirmed outcomes with proper indexing for future comparison and training.
  • Incorporate feedback from physical examinations, seizures, and supervisory reviews to update case records and enhance image interpretation accuracy.
  • Identify and report recurring concealment patterns, commodities, routes, or image analysis trends to supervisors for strategic insights.
  • Ensure confidentiality, integrity, and authorized handling of scanner images, cargo data, and analytical findings, complying with access control, data retention, and information security requirements.
  • Participate in proficiency testing, refresher training, case review sessions, and quality assurance initiatives to maintain high standards of image reading accuracy and consistency.
  • Adhere to the organization's standards regarding conduct, punctuality, and performance while performing all duties.
  • Maintain medical fitness including visual acuity and color vision suitable for prolonged screen viewing, with compliance to periodic health certifications.
  • Adapt to flexible work hours including rotating and night shifts, ensuring sustained concentration and accuracy under varying conditions.

title: Data Analyst (Entry to Mid Level)
description_html: Located in DHA Phase 1, Lahore, this full-time Junior Data Analyst position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to data-driven decision-making within a dynamic organization. The role operates from 3 PM to 12 AM and requires a minimum of one year of relevant experience. The ideal candidate will have hands-on skills in SQL, Power BI, and Python, and will be responsible for analyzing datasets, generating actionable insights, and creating reports and dashboards that support business objectives. Key Responsibilities - Collect, clean, validate, and analyze data from various sources to ensure accuracy and reliability. - Write and optimize SQL queries to efficiently extract, filter, and manipulate data. - Develop interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI to visualize key performance metrics. - Utilize Python for data analysis, preprocessing, and automation of routine tasks, leveraging libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. - Identify trends, patterns, and discrepancies within datasets to inform strategic business decisions. - Prepare regular reports and communicate key findings clearly to relevant teams and stakeholders. - Maintain data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all reporting systems. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver actionable insights that enhance organizational performance. Required Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field. - At least one year of professional experience in data analysis or a similar role. - Strong proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Python programming. - Familiarity with Python libraries such as Pandas and NumPy is preferred. - Solid understanding of data visualization techniques, data cleaning processes, and basic statistical concepts. - Ability to interpret complex data and present findings in a clear and understandable manner. - Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. - Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment. Preferred Qualifications and Benefits - Experience in developing Power BI dashboards and data models to enhance reporting capabilities. - Familiarity with Excel and advanced data reporting techniques. - Basic understanding of ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and database management. - Competitive monthly salary of Rs50,000. - Work location is in-person at DHA Phase 1, Lahore. This position is well-suited for a motivated Junior Data Analyst eager to advance their career by applying technical skills to real-world business challenges while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
